meta_title: Project Management Assistance — LOC RÉACTION S.A.S
title: Steering your projects, with peace of mind
subtitle: LOC RÉACTION S.A.S supports public and private project owners in managing their real estate and infrastructure projects.
what_text: Project Management Assistance (AMO) means supporting the project owner — the party commissioning and funding a project — in the technical, administrative and financial steering of the works, without replacing them.
f1_text: Drafting and managing works contracts with contractors.
f2_text: Technical and financial coordination of all project stakeholders.
f3_text: Management and follow-up of subcontracting through to project handover.
f4_text: Support in optimising the costs and features of your project.
who_text: Local authorities, housing bodies, developers, businesses and individuals leading a real estate or infrastructure project of some scale.
cta_text: Let's talk about your project management assistance needs.
